patch.value: Raise pm-ops enforced source coverage to 100/100/100/100

The current fail-closed coverage gate is real but ratcheted only to 94% lines, 78% branches, and 95% functions; the verified full gate reports 94.32/78.45/95.04. Production readiness requires complete statement, branch, function, and line coverage without ignore directives, generated fixtures, or tests that merely execute code without asserting behavior.

Coverage configuration enforces 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines; All source reaches 100/100/100/100 through meaningful unit, integration, installed-CLI, and failure-path assertions; Negative controls prove each threshold cannot be bypassed by missing reports, omitted source files, ignore comments, or changed reporter output
Use c8 source reports to map each uncovered branch to a behavioral requirement; reject coverage ignore comments and synthetic assertions.
Make every source behavior observable and regression-protected across supported CLI, SDK, platform, and failure paths.
Prevents untested error recovery, output routing, platform branches, and parser edge cases from shipping across fleet automation.
The coverage gate fails below 100% for statements, branches, functions, or lines, and the complete behavioral suite meets all four thresholds.
The fleet-wide mandate is 100/100/100/100, while the current verified gate is materially below it and must not be represented as complete.
